numerator: unique h_policy rows with issued_at in the month; a Renewal issues a new policy and counts
where_to_get: saved query — policies issued by month; the BI tool issuance view mirrors it
traps: Count only after month end; mid-month figures are partial; cancellations inside cooling-off are not subtracted (see CAN-G1)

meaning: Median days from case creation to Policy issued
numerator: median of (issued_at − created_at) per issued case
traps: Issued cases only; cases still open at maturity are excluded so report ELG-M1 to VER-M1 beside it; on-hold time is included

meaning: Share of quoted cases that start eligibility
numerator: unique h_case rows at stage Eligibility or later by maturity
denominator: unique h_case rows created at Quote in the cohort week
traps: Do not use quote_started as the denominator: analytics counts devices not cases; unknown-language cases stay in the denominator

meaning: Share of eligibility starts that reach Documents with a tier assigned
numerator: unique cases with a tier assigned at stage Documents or later by maturity
denominator: cases quoted in the cohort week that entered Eligibility
traps: Cases with engine outcome refer (see 04) are open and stay in the denominator; a declined case that re-enters is counted once

numerator: unique cases whose checklist was complete at first submission
denominator: cases quoted in the cohort week that made a first submission by maturity
traps: Maturity covers the 7-day resubmission window and the 30-day hold; a checklist is per product and shop type so compare within shop type first; document_uploaded fires per file not per case

numerator: unique cases whose earliest h_verification row with outcome_source in (officer; field) has outcome pass
denominator: cases quoted in the cohort week that entered Verification by maturity
traps: Engine rows are re-runs not first passes; provider-failed is not a fail and pauses the case; maturity covers the hold window

meaning: Rework cycle time — median hours from rework raised to resubmitted
numerator: median of (resubmitted_at − raised_at) per rework item
traps: Items never resubmitted are excluded so report REW-G1 beside this; a median hides the long tail

numerator: unique cases with a payment provider confirmation
denominator: cases quoted in the cohort week that entered Placement by maturity
traps: Use the payment provider confirmation not the Harbor payment_completed event alone: links sent on WhatsApp complete outside Harbor; maturity covers the 7-day payment window and the hold

numerator: unique cases accepted by the first insurer chosen
denominator: unique cases placed in the week
traps: Two partners run on email; their acceptance is recorded by hand in Desk and lags

meaning: Claims acknowledged within the service level
numerator: unique claims with acknowledged_at − opened_at within the service level
denominator: unique claims opened in the month
traps: The service level is a policy value in context/policies/service-levels.md; a claim opened by phone has no claim_opened event so count from h_claim

numerator: policies issued with a referral agent attached at Quote
traps: Population is issued policies and says nothing about unissued referred cases; attribution is set at Quote and a referral added later is not counted

meaning: Verification queue cases worked within the service level
numerator: unique cases entering the queue whose earliest officer or field outcome is within 24 hours of entry
denominator: unique cases entering the verification queue in the week
traps: operational — unverified until the BI tool has a view; provider-failed pauses the clock; engine rows are not outcomes

meaning: Rework items resubmitted within the resubmission window
numerator: rework items resubmitted within 7 days of being raised
denominator: rework items raised in the week
traps: operational — unverified; a field capture counts as a resubmission; items on a case that went on hold are included

numerator: policies cancelled within the cooling-off period
maturity: month end plus the cooling-off period
traps: operational — unverified; population is issued policies; mature only after the cooling-off period closes for the whole month; an anti-metric for any feature that lifts PAY-M1

meaning: Rework items raised per case — rises if officers return documents the customer could not have known about
denominator: unique cases that entered Verification in the cohort week
where_to_get: h_rework_item joined to h_case by case id; count per case
traps: a case with several documents returned at once counts each item; exclude cases declined before any item
target: no target — watched beside VER-M2; a rise above 1.6 (`example`) triggers a reason-code review
